example_flows.t: Lipstick: one studio shot becomes a vanity scene and a shade swatch
example_flows.d: The starting photo was a single coral lipstick on a plain studio background. From it we made a scene on a marble vanity beside a mirror and a fresh flower, and a close-up next to a swatch of the same shade, so shoppers can judge the color before they buy.

example_flows.t: Hoodie: a flat product photo becomes street style and a flat lay
example_flows.d: We started with a front view of a plain gray hoodie. From it we made an image of someone wearing it on an autumn street and a flat lay on a wooden bench with a beanie and a scarf, so the same item works on a product page and in social posts.

example_flows.t: Coffee beans: a plain bag in a kitchen and at a breakfast table
example_flows.d: We started with a photo of a kraft coffee bag with a blank label and a scatter of beans. From it we made a kitchen counter scene with a pour-over brewer and a mug, and a breakfast table with a croissant, so the product looks at home in the moments people drink it.

faq.q: What can I make with AIVideosUGC?
faq.a: Short video ads, product and unboxing videos, white-background photos, lifestyle photos, model photos and social ad images. Most start from a photo of your product.
A clear photo of the product you sell. A phone photo on a plain background works well. Only upload photos you own or have permission to use.

faq.q: How long are the videos, and what sizes can I get?
faq.a: Videos are 6, 10 or 15 seconds. Choose 9:16 for TikTok, Reels and Shorts, 1:1 for feeds, or 16:9 for wider placements.
You see the credit cost before you start. Credits are held when your job starts and used when it is delivered. If something fails, you get the credits back.
